scope: Re-judge the 16 scripted calibration fixtures and the 160 finished episodes (128 development, 32 held-out) of the Haiku 4.5 decision-algorithms cohort with Sonnet 4.6 as a stronger cross-model judge: 2 views x 3 draws = 1,056 judge calls, no actor inference. Measures per-draw and aggregated agreement with the effect journal, vote split, within-lineage pairwise ranking error on the reported probability, prior collapse, and whether cited turns hit the first incident.
authorization: User asked on 2026-11-02 to update the design docs and run new experiments applying the Cooper et al. (arXiv:2607.27499) argument-rating methodology to judge reliability; Anthropic key from the desktop .env.
stopping: Stop on provider/budget/integrity errors. Persist every draw before and after its request. Resume only draws that never started; a started draw that did not settle is recorded as interrupted and never retried.
